create_unit_extractor: create a UnitExtractor instance to convert raw audio into discrete units using wav2vec2 and kmeans
run_predict: run the predict method on a UnitExtractor to extract speech units from audio file or tensor input
run_resynthesize_audio: run resynthesize_audio to reconstruct wav audio from extracted speech units using a vocoder
test_unit_extractor: test the UnitExtractor class initialization with model name, kmeans uri, device, and dtype parameters
review_predict: review the predict method that normalizes audio, extracts features from wav2vec2 layer, and maps to kmeans units
